justification: Both surfaces show the same basic scheme of a horizontal upper register containing a row of repeated small quadrupeds in profile, set above a lower field carrying one or more larger animal figures in the same flat, outlined low-relief idiom with schematic legs and curving necks. The clearest difference in depicted content is that A includes additional distinct motifs — a net/zigzag band, a small human-like figure, and a prominent long-necked bird head at the base — which are not identifiable on B, whose figures are too worn to confirm anything beyond generic animal forms.
